parts.name: Front Brake
parts.description: A single hydraulic caliper on a 296 mm disc, with ABS.
parts.function: Provides most of the bike's stopping power. Squeezing the lever pressurizes brake fluid, which pushes the caliper pistons and clamps the pads onto the disc.

parts.name: Front Brake Disc (296 mm)
parts.description: A 296 mm steel rotor bolted to the front hub. The diameter in the 3D view matches the Honda spec; the side it is mounted on is representative.
parts.function: The friction surface the pads clamp. It turns the bike's motion into heat.

parts.name: Front Brake Caliper
parts.description: A single hydraulic caliper mounted on a fork slider.
parts.function: Hydraulic pressure pushes its pistons, which press the brake pads against the disc.
parts.verificationNote: The caliper type is Honda-published. Piston count, mounting side and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

service.notes: Caliper mounting bolt torque not yet verified. Consult the Honda service manual (61MLH00).

parts.name: Front Brake Pads
parts.function: Wear-surface contact with the disc. Inspect them regularly and replace them at the wear limit.
parts.verificationNote: The part number and wear limit are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Front Brake Master Cylinder
parts.description: The lever-operated hydraulic pump with its fluid reservoir, on the right handlebar.
parts.function: Turns lever force into hydraulic pressure in the front brake line.

parts.name: Front Brake Line
parts.description: Hydraulic hose and pipe running from the master cylinder through the ABS modulator to the caliper. The routing shown is representative.
parts.function: Carries pressurized brake fluid to the caliper.
parts.verificationNote: Routing and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
